index.title: Site name — one line on what it offers and to whom
index.description: A short description of the site and its audience, at least 120 characters.
index.heading: Home headline: what you offer and to whom
index.lead: These pages are a neutral skeleton with no visual identity: write the offer, the audience and the primary action here, then design from the request itself.
index.servicesLead: Three services with their names and outcomes. Change the number and the sections as the request needs.
index.serviceOne: Two lines on the service and what the customer gets.
index.serviceTwo: Two lines on the service and what the customer gets.
index.serviceThree: Two lines on the service and what the customer gets.
index.about: A short paragraph about the owner: who they are, what they know, what sets them apart. Replace it with real facts from the request.

contact.title: Contact — Site name
contact.description: Contact details: email and phone, and when the team responds.
contact.heading: Contact
contact.lead: Say how a visitor reaches you and when the team responds. The email and phone below are placeholders to replace with real details.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Site name
privacy.description: What this page collects, why, and how it is kept.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.bodyOne: List the data the page collects (form, analytics, cookies) and why.
privacy.bodyTwo: State how long it is kept, who can see it, the visitor's right to have it deleted, and how to ask.
privacy.bodyThree: This is placeholder copy for the skeleton; replace it with a real policy the owner reviews before publishing.

terms.title: Terms — Site name
terms.description: Terms of using the site and the services offered.
terms.heading: Terms
terms.bodyOne: Write the terms of using the site and services: what is allowed, what is not, and who is responsible for what.
terms.bodyTwo: State the commitments, intellectual property and limits of liability as the owner requires.
terms.bodyThree: This is placeholder copy for the skeleton; replace it with real terms the owner reviews before publishing.

notFound.title: Page not found — Site name
notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.lead: The link may have changed or the page was removed. Start again from home.
